items.t: Amazon Stock: What Wall Street’s Latest Forecasts Say About Its Next Move
items.sum: AWS just posted its fastest growth in nearly five years, yet Amazon is bleeding cash at a record pace. Can a $220 billion spending binge pay off, or will free cash flow break the bull case first?

items.t: Walmart Is Amazon, But With 4,600 Stores
items.sum: Analysts keep comparing Walmart to Amazon, and the latest earnings give them fresh ammunition. But the growth behind those online numbers depends on a labor-heavy trick Amazon never needed, and the costs are climbing.

items.t: Billionaire Dan Loeb Exited Amazon and Opened $1 Billion in Meta, Nvidia and Microsoft Stakes
items.sum: Third Point dumped every Amazon share and bet big on three other AI giants, but the stocks have sunk since the filing's cutoff date. What did Dan Loeb see in their profits that Amazon's cash burn couldn't match?

items.t: “Such A Funny Idea.” Jeff Bezos’ $41 Billion Startup Could Drive “Civilizational Wealth,” But He Doesn’t See Merging It With Amazon “Right Now”
items.sum: Asked whether his AI startup would fold into Amazon and Blue Origin, Jeff Bezos laughed it off, then chose his words carefully. One short phrase in his answer hints the door may not be shut for good.
